create_gemma3n_model: create a Gemma3n language model from a Gemma3nConfig with optional device and dtype
create_gemma3n_model_from_factory: use Gemma3nFactory to build a full Gemma3n model with audio tower support
create_gemma3n_decoder_layer: create a Gemma3n decoder layer with AltUp, LAuReL, and PLE components
create_gemma3n_decoder: create a Gemma3n decoder with configurable AltUp inputs and RMSNorm layer normalization
create_gemma3n_final_projection: create a final output projection with optional softcapped logit wrapping
